messages.subject: ‘RHadoop’ is not available (for R version 3.1.1)
parts:
Hi,
I tried to install rmr and RHdoop and got the following warning:
"Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘RHadoop’ is not available (for R version 3.1.1)"

Should I change my R version?

TKS,
Sagi

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: ‘RHadoop’ is not available (for R version 3.1.1)
parts:
RHadoop is not a package, so that's not going to work with any version. None of the RHadoop packages in on CRAN, so that's another reason why it can't work. The bigger question here is: do you want to read the documentation? If you don't, these packages are not appropriate for you. These are no iPhones. You need to put some effort in them and they will put at the outer limits of what R can do scale-wise. "The first things the crosses my mind should work" is not the right attitude with these packages. I wish we could make it so, but it's always a trade-off between ease of use and power and also between what one would like to achieve and what is actually possible under the circumstances.


Antonio
